title: Equality and Object Identity
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of equality and object identity using at least one correct term from the lesson.

Identify one relevant edge case, debugging step, or version/platform constraint.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Equality and Object Identity** as part of **Advanced Properties and Class Modeling**. Classes group state and behavior; primary constructors and properties keep ordinary domain models concise, while initialization order still matters. Use the subtopics—Structural Equality with ==, Referential Equality with ===, Implementing equals() and hashCode()—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: These concepts help you model domain rules and reusable APIs. Good boundaries reduce accidental mutation, unsafe casts, and code that is difficult to extend.
